_doc: Tools/produce_fighter_clips.py spec. Canvas px: the guard key is scaled so the figure is body_px tall, feet centred on (body_x, feet_y). Keys are Qwen Image Edit 2.1 edits of the guard key; every action is chained MiniMax H3 first/last-frame segments between keys, so the contact frame is a segment boundary. Segment frames must be 8n+1 (24 fps).
look: the elf wild-woman with long curly strawberry-orange hair and a red hibiscus flower, pointed ears, golden eyes, a red floral bikini top and red floral sarong skirt, gold bracelets, laced sandals and a glowing crystal fire spear

guard.stance: feet apart, knees bent, holding the fire spear in both hands pointed forward to the right at chest height, its flaming tip toward the enemy

basic_hit.pose: a quick spear jab: the fire spear thrust forward to the right at chest height with both hands, arms extended, weight on the front leg

thrust_hit.pose: a deep lunging thrust: the fire spear driven fully forward to the right, her front knee deeply bent and back leg straight, body stretched out along the spear

spin_hit.pose: a wide spinning sweep: the fire spear swung horizontally out to the right at waist height in one hand, her body turned, hair and skirt flying out from the spin

support.pose: rallying: she holds the fire spear upright beside her in one hand and throws the other fist up, laughing wildly

slam.pose: she drives the fire spear point-first down into the ground in front of her to the right with both hands, crouched low, hair flying up

block.pose: bracing for impact: she leans back onto her rear foot with knees deeply bent and shoulders hunched, chin tucked, holding the fire spear level in both hands exactly as in image 1, pointing forward to the right

hit.pose: recoiling from a hit: her head and shoulders snapped back toward the left side of the picture, eyes squeezed shut, weight on her back foot, holding the fire spear level in both hands exactly as in image 1, pointing forward to the right

down.pose: knocked out: she lies collapsed on her side on the ground with her eyes closed and her limbs slack, her head toward the right side of the picture, the whole body lying along the same ground line

victory.pose: a victory pose: she twirls the fire spear above her head with one hand and winks with a big grin, the other hand on her hip

segments: She bounces lightly in her stance with the fire spear ready, hair and skirt swaying. A subtle idle loop: she ends exactly as she began.
She rocks back onto her rear foot and winces with her eyes shut, keeping the spear level in both hands.
She opens her eyes and settles back into her fighting stance, the spear still level.
Snap into the brace (blockstun): a cut to the block key, no H3 render.
She straightens up into her fighting stance, the spear still level.
She is knocked off her feet and collapses onto the ground, lying still.
She straightens up and strikes a triumphant victory pose.
She snaps a quick spear jab forward to the right.
She recovers and returns to her fighting stance.
She draws the spear back, then lunges forward in a deep powerful thrust to the right.
She recovers and returns to her fighting stance.
She spins and swings the fire spear in a wide horizontal sweep out to the right.
She recovers and returns to her fighting stance.
She plants the spear upright beside her and throws her fist up, laughing.
She lowers her fist and returns to her fighting stance.
She leaps and drives the fire spear point-first down into the ground in front of her with both hands.
She pulls the spear free and returns to her fighting stance.
